# network.find_best_polygon { #cflowdist.network.find_best_polygon }

```python
network.find_best_polygon(gdf, pt)
```

Find the polygon in gdf that best matches the point.

Rule:

  - If point is contained in one or more polygons -> choose polygon with closest centroid.
  - Else -> choose polygon with closest centroid.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                   | Default    |
|--------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| gdf    | gpd.GeoDataFrame | GeoDataFrame containing the polygons to be searched.          | _required_ |
| pt     | Point            | Shapely Point object representing the location to be matched. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | str    | The identifier of the best matching polygon (e.g., canton name or code). |
